items.title: Josiah 'Cie' Frazier Interview, 1972-01-19
items.q: The interviewee discusses the Sam Morgan band and mentions Henry Russ only in response to the interviewer's statement that Russ played with them; the interviewee does not claim personal interaction or a specific role with Russ.

ctx.x: But the reason with Sam Morgan, man, I can't pitch him.
I can't pitch him. I pitch him Henry and Russ playing with them. When did that young band start out? Was that in the late 20s or something?

Oh, yeah, during the 20s, that was all in their range. All them bands were separate to themselves. The young Morgan Band was to itself, Sam he was to himself. I see. You see them guys there was two brothers.
